crossRefs.note: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth; break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child: for…
But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of…

translations.web: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.
translations.bsb: “Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
translations.kjv: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
translations.asv: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man-child.
